text: {"claims": [{"id": "c1", "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "2000000000 + 2000000000", "op": "==", "value": "4000000000"}, "reasoning": "P1.S2 gives two billion older and two billion newer XIDs; P0.S1 confirms 32-bit XIDs wrap after more than 4 billion transactions."}, {"id": "c4", "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "refutes"}, {"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "refutes"}], "reasoning": "P2.S1 only says data loss 'could result', and P0.S3/P7.S0 state the data remains and a manual VACUUM fixes it, refuting 'permanent, unrecoverable'."}, {"id": "c6", "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "200000000 / 2000000000", "op": "==", "value": "0.1"}, "reasoning": "Default autovacuum_freeze_max_age is 200 million (P5.S4), triggered per P2.S2, against the two-billion circular XID space of P1.S2 — 10%."}, {"id": "c8", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "refutes"}, {"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "0.95 * 200000000", "op": "==", "value": "180000000"}, "reasoning": "Max is 0.95 × autovacuum_freeze_max_age (P4.S0); with default 200M (P5.S4) that is 190 million, not 180 million."}, {"id": "c11", "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "40000000 - 3000000", "op": "==", "value": "37000000"}, "reasoning": "Warnings begin at forty million before wraparound (P6.S0) and XID assignment stops at fewer than three million (P7.S1), leaving 37 million."}]}
